newsitem.title: USA: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates fell in wk ending 7/25.
newsitem.headline: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates fell in wk ending 7/25.

text.p: Average commitment rates on U.S. 30- and 15-year fixed-rate mortgages fell slightly during the week ending July 25, Freddie Mac said Thursday.

Thirty-year mortgages in the week fell to an average 7.43 percent from 7.47 percent last week. Fifteen-year mortgages fell to an average 6.98 percent from 7.01 percent last week, Freddie Mac reported.
One-year adjustable rate mortgages were also down slightly, falling to 5.54 percent in the week from 5.55 percent last week.
A year ago, the 30-year rate averaged 8.19 percent, the 15-year 7.71 percent and the ARM 6.01 percent.
